title: What Is Artificial Pollination?
content: Artificial pollination is the process of transferring pollen from one flower to another manually using hands or simple tools.

title: Why Is Artificial Pollination Necessary in Rooftop Gardening?
content: Artificial pollination is necessary because natural pollination is often low on rooftops due to fewer bees and limited insect activity.

title: Which Plants Commonly Need Artificial Pollination?
content: Plants such as gourd, pumpkin, bitter gourd, fenugreek, and jhing often require artificial pollination for better fruit set.

title: What Tools Can Be Used for Artificial Pollination?
content: Small brushes, quills, cotton swabs, fans, or simple pollen sprays can be used for artificial pollination.

title: How Is Artificial Pollination Performed?
content: Artificial pollination is done by gently transferring pollen from male flowers to female flowers using a light brush or cotton swab.

title: When Is the Best Time to Do Artificial Pollination?
content: Artificial pollination should be done in the morning after the flowers have fully opened for best results.

title: How Long Does It Take to See the Effects of Artificial Pollination?
content: The effects of artificial pollination can be seen within 5-7 days, when young fruits begin to develop after successful pollination.

title: What Other Practices Help Increase Yield Besides Artificial Pollination?
content: Yield can be further increased through regular irrigation, proper fertilizer application, and effective pest and disease control.

title: When Is the Best Time to Perform Artificial Pollination?
content: Artificial pollination should be carried out in the morning after flowers have fully opened for maximum success.

title: Which Plants Commonly Require Artificial Pollination?

title: Why Does Yield Remain Low Without Artificial Pollination?
content: Yield remains low without artificial pollination mainly due to the absence of bees or other natural pollinating insects on rooftops.

title: How Often Should Artificial Pollination Be Checked or Performed?
content: Flowers should be inspected every 2-3 days, and artificial pollination should be performed whenever new female flowers appear.
